def transform(grid):
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(x != 8 for x in row)]
    cols = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[r][c] != 8 for r in rows)]
    top, bottom = min(rows), max(rows)
    left, right = min(cols), max(cols)
    inner = next(c for c in colors if c != border)
    shift = max(sum(grid[r][c] == inner for c in cols) for r in rows) + 1
    mid = (top + bottom) // 2
    colors = sorted({grid[r][c] for r in rows for c in cols if grid[r][c] != 8})
    border = grid[top][left]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in rows:
        for c in cols:
            out[r][c] = 8
    for r in rows:
        offset = shift if r <= mid else 0
        for c in cols:
            value = grid[r][c]
            if value != 8:
                out[r][c + offset] = inner if value == border else border
    return out
